BEYOND TASHKENT · 2025

TEDxWIUT at TEDxOxford

In February 2025, members of the TEDxWIUT community travelled from Uzbekistan to Oxford to attend TEDxOxford and connect with the wider TEDx community. The visit brought TEDxWIUT beyond its home stage in Tashkent and into one of the world's most historic university cities.

TEDxOxford 2025 was held at the Sheldonian Theatre under the theme “What If?”, bringing together twelve speakers for a day of ideas, conversations and exchange.

2 February 2025Sheldonian TheatreOxford, United KingdomTheme: What If?

ABOUT THE ARCHIVE

A permanent home for TEDxWIUT.

TEDxWIUT brings together speakers, organizers and audiences around ideas worth spreading. This archive preserves the events, talks and people who have shaped its story at Westminster International University in Tashkent.

TEDxWIUT is an independently organized TEDx event. TEDx events are independently organized under license from TED.
